በይእቲ: ይእቲ — on that, in that (በ- + 3fs pronoun/demonstrative 'she, that')
ወንጽሕት: ንጹሕ — and pure (ወ- + adjective, fem. sg.)
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
ወባቲ: በ — and by it, with it (ወ- + preposition በ + -ቲ '3fs', ባቲ)
በእንቲአሃ: በእንተ — for her, on her account (preposition በእንተ with 3fs suffix -ሃ, stem በእንቲአ-)
ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
ነበረት: ነበረ — she stayed, remained (3fs perfect, n-b-r)
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
ወትከውን: ኮነ — and you will be (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, k-w-n; the same letters could be 3fs 'she', see the unit note) · 3fs 'and she/it will be' agreeing with ምድር (ወትከውን ሎቱ ዛቲ ምድር 'and this land will be his')
ለሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — people (noun, construct 'people of'; ለ- marks the object of the verb)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity') · 'of the world', the owner after an anticipating suffix (ብርሃኖ ለዓለም 'the light of the world') · 'for ever' also after ካህኑ: 'his priest for ever', or 'priest of the world' (?)
ተጸውረት: ተጸውረ — she was carried (3fs perfect, passive tä-stem of ጾረ 'carry'; subject ባሕርይ)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
አመ: አመ — on, at the time of, when (preposition / conjunction)
በጽሐ: በጽሐ — he reached, arrived (3ms perfect, G, b-ṣ-ḥ)
እምዘርእከ: ዘርእ — from your seed (እም- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
ይቤለኒ: ብህለ — he said to me (3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ለኒ 'to me')
ለእለ: እለ — those who, who (plural relative pronoun; ለ- 'to, for')
ለባሕርይ: ባሕርይ — the pearl (ለ- marking the object, resumed by -ዋ in ጾርክምዋ)
እምከርሠ: ከርሥ — from the womb of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
አዳም: አዳም — Adam · (?) as predicate in ወኵሉ ርእየቱ አዳም, probably an adjective 'pleasing, comely' (from the sense; unconfirmed); 'Adam' as the first perfect man also possible · Adam, in ዘመደ አዳም 'the kin of Adam' (the human race; ch. 53) · (?) as predicate in ኢኮነ አዳም 'it is not comely' (of ላሕይ 'appearance'), read like the earlier predicate use, 'pleasing, comely' (?); 'ruddy' (cf. አደመ 'be red') is the alternative (?)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
እምግብርናት: ግብርና — from servitudes (እም- + plural ግብርናት; abstract) (?)
ሖረት: ሖረ — she went (3fs perfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?)
ትከውን: ኮነ — you will be (2ms imperfect) · also 3fs 'she/it becomes, is' (እንተ ትከውን ሲሳየ 'which is food')
ወአመ: አመ — and when, on the day that (ወ- + conjunction/preposition)
እምብዝኀ: ብዝኅ — from the abundance of (እም- 'from' + noun ብዝኅ 'multitude', construct ብዝኀ)
ዘይከውን: ኮነ — who will be (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect)
ወበደኃሪ: ደኃሪ — and in the latter, last
ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
፫: ፫ — 3, spoken ሠለስቱ (śälästu) 'three'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'three' (መጠነ ፫ እመት 'to the measure of three cubits'; ፫ ልብስ 'three garments'); spoken ሠለስ (śäläs) (?) before a feminine noun such as እመት, ሠለስቱ with a masculine
መድኀኒተ: መድኀኒት — salvation, saviour (noun; accusative predicate: 'you will be a salvation', i.e. a saviour)
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
ዘነሥአ: ነሥአ — who took (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
አቡከ: አብ — father (noun, genitive after construct; + -ከ 'your', 2ms, form አቡ-)
ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
አድራሚ: አድራሚ — Adrami (?) (name of a son of Solomon (?); form obscure, possibly corrupt) (?)
ዘይንእስ: ንእሰ — who is younger, small (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, n-ʾ-s)
በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ተኀየለ: ተኀየለ — he prevailed, grew strong (3ms perfect, ተ- stem, ḫ-y-l)
ወሰገደ: ሰገደ — and he bowed down (ወ- + 3ms perfect, s-g-d)
ኣአኵቶ: አኰተ — I give thanks to him, praise (1cs imperfect, G + -ኦ '3ms him'; written ኣአኵቶ)
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will')
ለእግዚእየ: እግዚእ — of/to my lord (ለ- + noun + -የ '1cs my')
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
ዘርእየ: ርእየ — what he saw (ዘ- 'what' + 3ms perfect, G)
አስተፈሥሐኒ: አስተፈሥሐ — it gladdened me (3ms perfect, causative-reflexive of ፈሥሐ + -ኒ 'me')
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
ነፍስየ: ነፍስ — my soul, my life (noun, fem. + -የ '1cs my')
እምይእዜሰ: ይእዜ — from now on, indeed (እም- + ይእዜ 'now' + enclitic -ሰ)
ኣፈቅራ: አፍቀረ — I love her (1cs imperfect, causative A-stem, spelled ኣ-, + -ኣ 'her')
ዘበ: በ — in, on (preposition; ዘ- 'that which (is)'; spaced off its noun in the edition)
እዴሁ: እድ — his hand (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; with suffix እዴ-)
ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
ቀደምት: ቀዳማይ — former, ancient, first (adjective, plural ቀደምት, agreeing with አበዊነ 'our fathers') (?)
ኀያላን: ኀያል — mighty men, warriors (noun, plural ኀያላን)
መንግሥተ: መንግሥት — kingdom (construct 'kingdom of') · also the plain accusative 'a kingdom' (ዘይነፍቅ መንግሥተ 'who would seize a kingdom')
መሓሪ: መሓሪ — merciful (active participle, agent noun of ምሕረ, m-ḥ-r)
ዘይምሕር: ምሕረ — who is merciful (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, m-ḥ-r)
ለመአብሳን: መአብስ — to the wrongdoers (ለ- + plural መአብሳን; perhaps from አበሰ 'sin') (?)
ኵለንታሁ: ኵለንታ — all of him, his whole self (noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ይደሉ: ደለወ — be fitting, be due (3ms imperfect)
